norwegian-jewel.name: Norwegian Jewel
norwegian-jewel.summaryDescription: The Norwegian Jewel is a mid-sized Alaska favorite offering classic Inside Passage and Gulf of Alaska itineraries.

juneau.dockLogisticsNotes: Norwegian Jewel commonly berths at the AJ Dock, positioned approximately 1 mile south of downtown Juneau. Shuttles or a 15–20 minute walk connect the dock to downtown tour staging areas.

sampleTours.title: Mendenhall Glacier Helicopter Landing & Guided Ice Walk
sampleTours.meetingLogistics: Shuttle pickup from South Franklin / Mt. Roberts Tram staging area.
sampleTours.highlight: Walk directly on the icefield with crampons and professional glaciology guides.

sampleTours.title: Auke Bay Guaranteed Whale Watching Safari
sampleTours.meetingLogistics: Bus transfer from downtown staging area to Auke Bay Marina (25 min each way).
sampleTours.highlight: High-speed catamaran designed with outdoor viewing decks for humpback whale bubble-net feeding.

sampleTours.title: Mendenhall Glacier Visitor Center & Rainforest Trail
sampleTours.meetingLogistics: Direct shuttle transfer from cruise dock staging zone.
sampleTours.highlight: Explore Nugget Falls trail and the official US Forest Service exhibits at your own pace.

skagway.dockLogisticsNotes: The Jewel usually docks within flat, easy walking distance of historic Broadway Street and the White Pass & Yukon Route railway platform.

sampleTours.title: White Pass Scenic Railway Summit Excursion
sampleTours.meetingLogistics: Direct boarding adjacent to cruise dock platform.
sampleTours.highlight: Climb nearly 3,000 feet past Bridal Veil Falls, Dead Horse Gulch, and vintage trestles.

sampleTours.title: Yukon Suspension Bridge & Klondike Highway Explorer
sampleTours.meetingLogistics: Mini-coach pickup near Broadway dock terminal.
sampleTours.highlight: Cross into Canadian territory with panoramic mountain passes (Passports strictly required).

ketchikan.dockLogisticsNotes: As a mid-sized ship, Norwegian Jewel often docks at downtown berths (Berth 2/3), allowing passengers to walk directly onto Front Street and Creek Street.

sampleTours.title: Misty Fjords National Monument Floatplane Safari
sampleTours.meetingLogistics: Short 5-minute walk to waterfront floatplane dock.
sampleTours.highlight: Soar above 3,000-foot granite sea cliffs and pristine glacial fjords.

sampleTours.title: Bering Sea Crab Fishermen’s Tour aboard the Aleutian Ballad
sampleTours.meetingLogistics: Departs directly from downtown cruise dock pier.
sampleTours.highlight: Live demonstration of king crab and sea creature hauling on a veteran fishing vessel.

norwegian-encore.name: Norwegian Encore
norwegian-encore.summaryDescription: The flagship of NCL’s Alaska fleet, featuring the Observation Lounge, race track, and Seattle roundtrips.

juneau.dockLogisticsNotes: Due to its large length, Norwegian Encore docks at AJ Dock. Plan for the AJ shuttle or a 15–20 minute waterfront stroll to reach downtown Juneau meeting points.

sampleTours.title: Auke Bay Whale Watching & Mendenhall Glacier Combo
sampleTours.meetingLogistics: Shuttle pickup at Mt. Roberts Tramway staging lot.
sampleTours.highlight: Combine guaranteed humpback whale spotting with guided time at Mendenhall Glacier.

skagway.dockLogisticsNotes: Docks along the Railroad/Ore docks. Morning queues for the White Pass train can be long; pre-booking early departure slots is recommended.

sampleTours.title: White Pass & Yukon Route Classic Train Tour
sampleTours.meetingLogistics: Dockside train boarding directly next to vessel gangway.
sampleTours.highlight: Ride vintage parlor cars through high mountain passes and historic gold-rush gorges.
